messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated p95/p99 latency detected for Sunburst Corp (VPC tenant) in eu2. Metric: p99 8.2s (baseline 1.1s). New alert ticket INC-174999 created. Paging @raj-oncall.

raj-oncall: Ack. Jumping in — what's the customer impact? Any errors or just latency?

lina-cust-eng: Customer reports user-facing timeouts for chat endpoints since ~11:03 UTC. They see retries and some 504s. Traffic is heavy (batch inference + long contexts).

ben-ml: Observations from telemetry: KV cache miss rate spiked on pod pool eu2-ml-3/4; average sequence length up ~2.6x. Token throughput steady. Looks like a small subset of tenants driving long-context sessions.

amy-sre: I'm taking lead. Initial plan: 1) throttle tenant temporarily, 2) isolate tenant to a temporary warm pool, 3) shift a portion of traffic to eu1 warm spare, 4) enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant.

ops-coordinator: @amy-sre want me to run the isolation command? I can do it from the control plane.

amy-sre: Yes please. Run: ```sh
redwoodctl tenant isolate --tenant sunburst --target-pool warm-eu2-temp --reason "p99 spike"
```

ops-coordinator: Running now. Response: isolation job queued id=iso-174999-1. Estimated attach ~45s.

ben-ml: While that attaches, enable routing override to shift 30% of traffic to eu1 warm spare: ```json
{ "tenant": "sunburst", "override": {"region":"eu1","percent":30} }
```

ops-coordinator: Posted routing override. Confirmed 30% shift visible in control plane metrics.

lina-cust-eng: I informed Sunburst CSM & support that we're isolating and shifting traffic. They asked for an ETA — telling them 10–15m for initial mitigation to show.

amy-sre: Also enabling model fallback for this tenant: switching to `redwood_q4_hf` (quantized) for new sessions to reduce memory/KV pressure. Command: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --tenant sunburst --model redwood_q4_hf --immediate true
```

amy-sre: Reducing batch window on eu2 serving nodes to lower tail: `--batch-window 8ms` applied to pool eu2-ml-*.

ben-ml: After changes, p95 dropped from 2.1s->1.2s, p99 trending down (was 8.2s now 3.4s). KV miss rate also decreasing.

raj-oncall: Good. Any sign of tenant eviction needed or persistent noisy sessions?

amy-sre: Not yet. If p99 remains >3s after 10m we may evict long-sessions (graceful disconnect) for this tenant. Will coordinate with Lina before taking action.

lina-cust-eng: Sunburst questions whether we can throttle only long-polling users — I'm proposing per-session token cap as a next step. I'll draft messaging.

ops-coordinator: Isolation job completed: iso-174999-1 attached to warm-eu2-temp. Metrics show load rebalanced.

incident-bot: Update: INC-174999 status -> mitigated. p99 1.05s, p95 0.9s. No errors remaining in last 2m. Continue monitoring for 30m.

raj-oncall: Nice work team. Amy — keep assigned. Lina — follow up with customer comms. I'll close the active paging after 30m stable. :thumbsup:

amy-sre: On it. Adding runbook notes under INC-174999: increased batch sensitivity, tenant isolation steps, routing override snippet, fallback model.

lina-cust-eng: Sending post-incident note to Sunburst now. Thanks all.

raj-oncall: Closing thread in 30m if stable.
